hooks.name: Typecheck and test the engine on save
hooks.description: When a file under packages/engine is saved, run the engine typecheck and then the engine tests once, printing each exit code.

action.command: echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) save-hook fired" >> .kiro/hook-runs.log; pnpm --filter @jacquard/engine typecheck; tc=$?; echo "TYPECHECK_EXIT_CODE=$tc"; pnpm --filter @jacquard/engine test; tt=$?; echo "TEST_EXIT_CODE=$tt"; echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) save-hook result: typecheck=$tc test=$tt" >> .kiro/hook-runs.log
